test.name: Tc_manualoffercreation_01 - Manual Offer Creation Seller and Operator Verification

test-method.name: tc_manualoffercreation_01_seller_creates_offer_operator_verifies
test-method.description: Verify a Seller can manually create an Offer for an existing catalog product in Mirakl, and that the Offer is visible and Active for both the Seller and the Operator

test.name: Tc_fileimportproductoffer_01 - Bulk Import Product and Offer via File, Accept, Sync, Publish

test-method.name: tc_fileimportproductoffer_01_bulk_import_and_publish
test-method.description: Verify a bulk product+offer Excel import is validated/auto-corrected, any invalid catalog data is corrected, the import is accepted by the Operator into the FDA Catalog, synced to Magento via Adobe Admin, ends with the product Published and the Offer Active, and finally appears correctly on the FDA storefront

test.name: Tc_manualproductandoffercreation_01 - Manual Product and Offer Creation, Accept, Sync, Publish

test-method.name: tc_manualproductandoffercreation_01_seller_creates_product_and_offer
test-method.description: Verify a Seller can manually create a brand-new Product and Offer via Price and Stock > Offers > Add Offer > Create Product, that the Operator can accept it into the FDA Catalog, that Adobe Admin syncs it to Magento, and that it ends up Published with an Active Offer, verified on the FDA storefront
